verse.verse_2: and by the night when it darkens,
verse.verse_3: your Lord has not forsaken you, nor is He displeased with you,
verse.verse_4: and the Hereafter will indeed be better for you than the present life;
verse.verse_5: soon you will be gratified with what your Lord will give you.
verse.verse_6: Did He not find you orphaned and shelter you?
verse.verse_7: Did He not find you wandering, and give you guidance?
verse.verse_8: Did He not find you in want, and make you free from want?
verse.verse_9: Therefore do not treat the orphan with harshness,
verse.verse_10: and do not chide the one who asks for help;
verse.verse_11: but proclaim the blessings of your Lord.
